purpose: Read-only integrity inventory of retained Phase 1–6 evidence; only this new audit JSON was written.

semantics.match: Expected hash matches a present repository file; explicit retained aliases are labeled.
semantics.bundle_match: Expected upstream source hash matches a retained archive member; original source checkout is not assumed present.
semantics.missing: Referenced repository/phase evidence file is absent.
semantics.external_unavailable: Original upstream source/build/download reference is absent from retained files and source archives; this is distinct from a missing repository evidence file.
semantics.mismatch: Present file hash differs from recorded value.
semantics.preservation: No prior evidence modified, restored, or replaced.

git_facts.interpretation: No current ignore rule was reported for absent log paths, no tracked .log files were listed, and no commits touching .log paths were found by the recorded all-ref history queries. These observations do not establish why the original logs are absent or whether an earlier external export omitted them.
